title: A Rainwater Project
text:
A
In 2022, a community garden in Eastbank began collecting rainwater from the roof of its tool shed. The garden team wanted to reduce its use of mains water. A mesh screen above the tank keeps leaves out. The team uses the collected water on plants and never supplies it as drinking water.

B
Every Monday, volunteers read the gauge and record the water level. During the first winter, the team found that a loose lid allowed rain to splash out. A local workshop supplied a tighter lid. The garden also put a marked watering can beside the tank so volunteers could measure how much they used.

C
The project coordinator argues that small rainwater projects should start with a simple design. In her view, a clear maintenance rota matters more than expensive equipment. The community garden is considering a second tank, but the team has not decided what size it will buy.
